# Microsoft Philly GPU trace: day-ahead new-machine sample

This is a deterministic sample of the public [Microsoft Research Philly trace](https://github.com/msr-fiddle/philly-traces/blob/29a1b87fa2d9ed80b83c9e3a37f3a88d382b031d/README.md), commit `29a1b87fa2d9ed80b83c9e3a37f3a88d382b031d`. It selects all minute-level GPU rows for raw machine IDs whose `int.from_bytes(SHA256(machineId UTF-8), "big") % 100` is in `[25,35)`. Earlier `<5`, `[5,15)`, and `[15,25)` samples have disjoint raw machine IDs. The source archive is not retained. It has 1,055,988,361 bytes and SHA256 `2037ccf63a725a02be718b0e1aeee6142c90b7f62d0d849295120e9f6ba13d2c`.

The [frozen protocol](../../../reports/philly_day_ahead_calibration_holdout_protocol_frozen.md) and [freeze record](../../../artifacts/philly_day_ahead_calibration_holdout_v1/freeze.json) predate collection. The streaming collection audit (`gpu_util_day_ahead_holdout_audit.json`) checks the full archive and 44,750,640 GPU CSV rows from 552 machines. Selected raw Parquet contains **4,585,892 rows from 58 machines**. First-row-width normalization audit (`gpu_util_normalized_first_width_audit.json`) preserves every selected row and records 2,580 irregular-width rows. The [score-free support audit](../../../artifacts/philly_day_ahead_calibration_holdout_v1/support_audit.json) confirms 41 eligible December 1–15, 2017 machines and 685,940 complete `below_80` decisions before labels were scored.

The official trace carries a [CC BY 4.0 license](https://github.com/msr-fiddle/philly-traces/blob/29a1b87fa2d9ed80b83c9e3a37f3a88d382b031d/LICENSE). The maintainers ask users to cite Jeon et al., [*Analysis of Large-Scale Multi-Tenant GPU Clusters for DNN Training Workloads*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.05758), USENIX ATC '19. The license and attribution apply to this derived sample. GPU utilization is not a user-facing SLO or measured VM scaling outcome.
